card.name: Body or material nouns after 'the'
card.fires_on: A concrete noun naming a material or body surface, such as skin, hair, membrane or tip. It follows a noun or 'wash the' in handling or physical-description text.

modes.label: Material part nouns

modes.example: Use the alcohol swab to wipe the rubber<< membrane>> at the tip of the syringe.
